messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2312345678 — Metric alert: quant-omega-v2 error-rate > 5% (eu-west-1) for 3m. Auto-escalation to oncall. ↩

Ryan (oncall): saw the alert, digging in. Can someone pull recent deploys for omega?

Maria (sre): I see a small spike in tail latency and a correlated increase in 4xx from the inference runtime. Looks like kv-cache misses spiked for quant-omega-v2 since 12:02 UTC. No recent infra deploys in eu-west-1.

Cheng (ml-eng): adding context — we rolled quant-omega-v2 (quantized) last week. Stable unquantized variant is quant-omega-stable. Filtering shows higher token rejection for long-context requests.

Julian (prod-eng): Support reporting user tickets about partial completions and weird truncation. @Alejandro can you collate any high-impact customers?

Alejandro (support): I have 3 customers reporting multiple truncated completions in the last 10m (one is a paying enterprise). Flagging as potential customer-impact. Opening a ticket and pinging account exec.

Ryan (oncall): ok plan proposal: 1) soft-throttle heavy keys that are causing long sequences, 2) route new sessions to quant-omega-stable, 3) temporarily disable quant-omega-v2 in eu-west-1 if step 2 doesn't reduce errors. Thoughts?

Maria (sre): agree. We should try routing first so customers see minimal disruption. I'll prepare the traffic-shift commands.

Cheng (ml-eng): +1. If we disable the quant variant we should ensure the stable variant has capacity. I can check autoscale headroom.

ops-bot: command log from runbook: get-variant-traffic --model quant-omega-v2 --region eu-west-1

```
{"quant-omega-v2": "45% of traffic (eu-west-1)", "quant-omega-stable": "50%", "other": "5%"}
```

Maria (sre): I'm going to apply a keywise emergency throttle for keys that are exceeding 20s p95. This is reversible. Running:

```
redwoodctl quota update --type keywise --limit 10rps --filter "model:quant-omega-v2 AND region:eu-west-1 AND p95>20s" --reason "mitigate runaway long requests"
```

Maria (sre): throttle applied. Monitoring for customer errors.

Alejandro (support): tickets show fewer repeats for one customer after throttle, but still seeing some partials.

Cheng (ml-eng): stable variant current CPU/GPU utilization in eu-west-1: 70% GPU mem, 65% infer load. Autoscaler can take ~20% more, should be ok to route some traffic.

Julian (prod-eng): I'll start routing a portion of new sessions off quant-omega-v2 -> quant-omega-stable. Command:

```
redwoodctl routing update --from quant-omega-v2 --to quant-omega-stable --region eu-west-1 --pct 30 --mode gradual
```

ops-bot: routing change applied: 30% gradual shift initiated.

Ryan (oncall): monitoring metrics — error-rate down to 3.4% in 2m. Latency tail still elevated. We need a contingency if stabilizes still >2.5% or customers remain impacted. Standby for decision.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by Ryan (oncall).

Maria (sre): after routing, errors slightly improved but not resolved for long-context keys. I recommend we temporarily disable quant-omega-v2 in eu-west-1 and failover all traffic to stable. That will fully remove the quant paths causing cache misses. We should announce to customers and note possible latency increase but better correctness.

Cheng (ml-eng): confirm stable has capacity for full failover? I reran projections — should be okay but expect 10-15% higher cost.

Ryan (oncall): decision: disable quant-omega-v2 in eu-west-1 now, apply emergency quota for keys still heavy, and page SRE to monitor. I will perform handoff to Maria in 15m for continued monitoring.

Maria (sre): executing disable:

```
redwoodctl variant disable --model quant-omega-v2 --region eu-west-1 --reason "emergency mitigation: increased errors and kv-cache misses" --force
```

ops-bot: variant disable request accepted. Rolling traffic to quant-omega-stable.

ops-bot: post-action check: all requests for previously targeted keys now served by quant-omega-stable. Error-rate eu-west-1 aggregated across models: 0.9%.

Alejandro (support): sending proactive note to affected customers: brief outage mitigation note and expected impact (slightly higher latency, correctness trade-off). Copying SRE runbook summary.

Cheng (ml-eng): capturing logs and trace samples for postmortem — saving KV miss traces and comparing to pre-deploy baseline.

Ryan (oncall): handing off to Maria for ongoing monitoring and post-incident follow-up. I'll update PD status and annotate incident with timeline.

Maria (sre): I have the watch. Next steps: 1) keep quant-omega-v2 disabled in eu-west-1, 2) gather perf traces + rerun regression test suite on quantized variant in a staging cluster, 3) prepare rollout plan for a fixed quant-omega-v2 (if validated) with canary at 1% then 10%.

Julian (prod-eng): I'll set up a postmortem board and link customer impact notes + decision log.

Alejandro (support): customers acknowledge the mitigation. One enterprise asked for a conference call — forwarding to account team.

Ryan (oncall): thanks team. Closing urgent actions. We'll reconvene for a 30m follow-up to scope the root cause.

ops-bot: INCIDENT 2312345678 status: mitigated -> action_taken: variant disabled, emergency throttle, traffic rolled to stable. Runbook ID: rb-2025-quant-fallback.

Maria (sre): adding final note — leave quant-omega-v2 disabled until Cheng's validation tests pass. I'll lock deployment gate for eu-west-1. :lock:
